$comment: Curated MCP server catalog. Every entry offers a static-key header mode and/or MCP-spec OAuth 2.1 as the vendor documents it; userUrl entries (Supabase, Augment) have per-account endpoints the user pastes at connect. Facts are the vendor's public docs (docsUrl) — a wrong one is an issue, not a patchbay finding. Every entry also has its vendor mark at icons/<id>.svg, folded in at build; an entry without one does not build. Request an entry with the 'Curated MCP server request' issue form.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: GitHub's official remote server — repositories, issues, pull requests, code search.
servers.note: Uses a Personal Access Token — its OAuth is not open to third-party clients (no dynamic client registration).

header.hint: Personal Access Token from github.com/settings/tokens (repo + read:org for full tool coverage)

local.note: official github-mcp-server via Docker; a native binary also exists — see Docs

servers.name: Figma
servers.description: Figma design context — frames, components, and variables from your files, for Dev Mode.
servers.note: Remote is gated on Figma's MCP client catalog (VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code are listed; new clients join a waitlist — patchbay's own OAuth client isn't listed yet, and running inside VS Code doesn't inherit VS Code's listing). The desktop app's local Dev Mode server is connectable today — see the local option.

local.note: Figma desktop app must be running with the local MCP server enabled (Preferences → Enable local MCP Server, or Dev Mode's inspect panel)

servers.name: Stitch
servers.description: Google Labs' Stitch — generates UI designs and screens from prompts.
servers.note: Key-only, sent as a Google API header.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.description: Stripe — customers, payments, subscriptions, and the Stripe docs.
servers.note: Connect with OAuth (recommended) or paste a restricted API key.

local.note: official @stripe/mcp; restrict tools and use a Restricted API Key

servers.name: Sentry
servers.description: Sentry — issues, errors, and traces from your organization.
servers.note: Connect with OAuth, or paste a personal token — Sentry's own recommended fallback for remote-IDE setups.

header.hint: User Auth Token from sentry.io settings (org:read, project:read)

local.note: official @sentry/mcp-server; auth token from your Sentry settings

servers.name: Postman
servers.description: Postman — collections, environments, and API requests from your workspace.
servers.note: US endpoint. EU accounts: use https://mcp.eu.postman.com as a custom integration (key-only there).

header.hint: API key from postman.com account settings

servers.name: Supabase
servers.description: Supabase — your project's database schema, SQL, edge functions, and logs.
servers.note: Endpoint is per-project — paste your project's MCP URL. OAuth works when the project's OAuth server has dynamic client registration enabled.

header.hint: Project API key from your Supabase dashboard

servers.name: Augment Context Engine
servers.description: Augment's context engine — semantic retrieval over your codebase.
servers.note: Endpoint and credentials come from app.augmentcode.com/mcp/configuration; remote indexing additionally needs Augment's GitHub App on the repo.

local.note: Auggie CLI (npm i -g @augmentcode/auggie), authenticated via `auggie login` first
